headline: Grupo México Profit Jumps 63 Percent on Higher Copper Prices
summary: Grupo México profit rose 63% to $1.97 billion in the third quarter as copper and silver prices surged, despite a 1.9% dip in copper output.
why: Grupo México is one of the world's largest copper producers. Its earnings directly reflect fluctuations in global base metal prices and industrial demand.

impacts.name: Grupo México
impacts.why: Higher market prices for copper and silver expanded corporate profit margins despite a slight drop in mined output volume.
